name: ARE 5474
title: Industrial Organization: Empirical Analysis
description: Analysis of the structure, conduct, and performance of industries with examples from the food sector and other industries. Explains the development of testable hypotheses from theory, empirical methods, evidence on the level and type of competition, economies of size, product differentiation, entry barriers, and the impact of alternative organizational forms including cooperatives on economic performance.
requirement_description: No requirements to take this course.
